title: PB Strawberry Oatmeal
description: Hot oatmeal cooked with frozen strawberries and milk, stirred through with whey protein and powdered peanuts — creamy, fast and filling.
steps: Add oats to a pot. Toast on medium heat 2 minutes until slightly browned.
Add milk, strawberries and a pinch of salt. Stir occasionally until thick (~3 minutes).
Remove from heat; transfer to a bowl. Add whey and powdered peanuts; mix well.
notes: Top with walnuts and/or banana for extra flavour. Powdered peanuts can be replaced with 10g regular peanut butter.
